BootId.description: The identifier of one boot of a Linux host: a UUID of any version in lowercase hyphenated form.

Marker.description: The value of `CANDLER_RUN` in a child's environment: an ASCII letter or digit, then letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`.

ProcessStart.description: When a process started, in the form its host reports: an object whose `kind` is `linux` (with `boot_id` and `ticks`), `darwin` (with `sec` and `usec`) or `unavailable`.

oneOf.description: A Linux process: the boot it ran in, and its start time in clock ticks since that boot.

boot_id.description: The identifier of the boot, so ticks of different boots are never compared.

ticks.$comment: Fits in 64 bits; a reader that holds numbers as doubles is exact only below 2^53.
ticks.description: The start time in clock ticks since boot, as `/proc/<pid>/stat` reports it.

oneOf.description: A macOS process: its start time as seconds and microseconds since the Unix epoch.

sec.$comment: Fits in 64 bits; a reader that holds numbers as doubles is exact only below 2^53.
sec.description: Whole seconds since the Unix epoch.

usec.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
usec.description: Microseconds, as the host reports them.

oneOf.description: The host reported no start time; the record never reads as alive.

Timestamp.$comment: The pattern states the lexical form; a date or time that names no instant, such as month 13, and a fraction of more than nine digits are refused by the parser.
Timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp with an uppercase `T` and an explicit offset, `Z` or `±HH:MM`.

description: The record the supervisor writes for a child: its process id, process group, start time, marker and spawn time, with the version marker `child-record/1` in `schema`.

marker.description: The value of `CANDLER_RUN` the child received.

pgid.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
pgid.description: The process group of the child, from 1.

pid.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
pid.description: The process id of the child, from 1.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `child-record/1`.

spawned_at.description: When the supervisor spawned the child.

title: ChildRecord
